name: Quick Disabilities of the Arm, Shoulder and Hand
description: 11-item abbreviated version of the DASH questionnaire. Strong correlation with full DASH (r=0.97). Lower score = less disability.
copyright: Free to use with attribution (Institute for Work & Health)
shirleySays: ICC 0.94. MDC: 15.9 pts. MCID: 15 pts. 11-item abbreviated version of DASH. Strong correlation with full DASH (r=0.97). Better for time-limited clinical settings. Validated in shoulder, rotator cuff, lateral epicondylitis, carpal tunnel, fractures.

scoring.mcidNote: 15-pt MCID; healthy adult mean ≈8; MDC 15.9 pts
